description: This file defines the IGrainRuntime interface in the Orleans framework, specifying methods and properties for interacting with the Orleans runtime environment, including grain activation management, timers, and storage.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Deactivates the provided grain when it becomes idle.

methods.name: DelayDeactivation
methods.description: Delays idle activation collection of the provided grain due to inactivity until at least the specified time has elapsed.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves grain storage for the provided grain, parameterized by grain state type.
